mechanism: Ketorolac may increase modafinil levels via CYP3A4 inhibition and competition for protein binding, while modafinil may induce CYP3A4 creating variable effects; NSAIDs also increase GI bleeding risk which modafinil's stimulant effects may mask.
action: Monitor for modafinil toxicity signs (insomnia, anxiety, tachycardia) and GI symptoms; use lowest effective ketorolac dose for shortest duration and consider gastroprotection.
